from slugify import slugify
cases = [
    ('Crème Brûlée', 'creme-brulee'),
    ('Ñandú', 'nandu'),
    ('Hello World', 'hello-world'),
    ('a -- b!!c', 'a-b-c'),
]
for text, want in cases:
    got = slugify(text)
    print(('ok ' if got == want else 'FAIL'), repr(text), '->', repr(got))
print(('ok ' if slugify('Hello World', sep='_') == 'hello_world' else 'FAIL'), 'custom sep ->', repr(slugify('Hello World', sep='_')))
